Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-designer` (`FieldDesigner.tsx`, `MetadataFieldsPage.tsx`) + `app-shell/services/MetadataService.ts`; routed `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, type Bug — live hard-block: authoring a lookup field through the field designer 422-blocks every later save of the object, and the read side loads existing lookups with an empty reference box. Family + fold-or-serial (answered): #6041/#6043/#6044 all come from the #5761 parity gate and touch the same files — **#6041 + #6044 are a fold candidate** (both are spelling-parity repairs toward the spec's declared key, each independently verifiable per key against the gate's ledger; all members now graded); **#6043 is excluded from the fold** (its resolution runs through the CEL expression-language question — a different repair shape) and serializes behind whichever lands first on these files. Per #5761's ruling each key keeps its own card either way — a fold shares the branch/PR with per-card commits and one `Fixes` line per member. Repair-direction note: the spec's `reference` is *required* for relationship types, so the rename changes what a half-filled draft does — that edge is in scope, not a surprise.

Clause-②: **yes** — the designer stops emitting keys `FieldSchema` refuses **by name**, so what a save accepts changes. Declared; Opus under this seat's recorded Fable-quota exemption.

**File surface:** `packages/plugin-designer` (`FieldDesigner.tsx`, `MetadataFieldsPage.tsx`) + `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts`, plus tests and a changeset.

## 裁决 — triage (2026-08-25 00:26Z), binding

> lands in `packages/plugin-designer` (`FieldDesigner.tsx`, `MetadataFieldsPage.tsx`) + `app-shell/services/MetadataService.ts`; `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, type **Bug** — **live hard-block**: authoring a lookup field through the field designer **422-blocks every later save of the object**, and the read side loads existing lookups with an **empty reference box**.
> Family + fold-or-serial (answered): #6041/#6043/#6044 all come from the **#5761 parity gate** and touch the same files — **#6041 + #6044 are a fold candidate** (both are spelling-parity repairs toward the spec's declared key, **each independently verifiable per key against the gate's ledger**; all members now graded); **#6043 is EXCLUDED from the fold** (its resolution runs through the CEL expression-language question — a different repair shape) and **serializes behind whichever lands first** on these files.
> Per **#5761's ruling each key keeps its own card either way** — a fold shares the branch/PR with **per-card commits and one `Fixes` line per member**.
> **Repair-direction note:** the spec's `reference` is **required** for relationship types, so the rename **changes what a half-filled draft does** — that edge is **in scope, not a surprise**.

## The two members

| card | designer emits | spec declares | consequence today |
|---|---|---|---|
| **#6041** | `referenceTo` on lookup fields | `reference` | `FieldSchema` refuses by name → **saving a lookup field hard-blocks the object** |
| **#6044** | `isSystem` | `system` | system-field detection reads a key **the server never sends**, and the key **round-trips back out as a 422** |

⛔ **#6043 (`formula` → `expression`) is NOT in this fold.** ⛔ Do not touch it, do not "fix it while you're there" — triage excluded it because a bare rename would ship **non-CEL expressions under a valid key**, i.e. a silent runtime failure **strictly worse than the loud 422**.

## PM mechanism assumptions — measure, do not inherit

1. ⛔ **Re-derive every site.** These were filed 2026-08-24 and `main` has moved a great deal overnight. Report each read/write site as you find it, ⛔ not as the card names it. (On #5234 tonight a card's line number was **stale by 147 lines**.)
2. ⚠️ **The rename has a behavioural edge the note names, and it is yours to handle:** `reference` is **required** for relationship types, so a **half-filled draft** that was previously savable (carrying `referenceTo`, ignored) may now fail validation, or vice-versa. ✅ Measure what a half-filled draft does **before and after**, and state it. ⛔ Do not discover this in review.
3. ⚠️ **There are two directions per key and they can be fixed independently — check both.** The write side (designer emits the wrong key → 422) **and** the read side (existing records load with an **empty reference box**, because the reader looks for the wrong key). ⚠️ Fixing only the write side leaves every already-saved field still unreadable. ✅ Say explicitly, per key, that both directions are covered.
4. ⚠️ **`MetadataService.ts` is shared with the read path** — confirm whether the round-trip (`isSystem` out → 422) is a **separate** site from the detection read, or the same one. The #6044 card describes both symptoms; they may or may not be one line.
5. ⚠️ **The #5761 parity gate has a ledger.** ✅ Each key is *"independently verifiable per key against the gate's ledger"* — so use the ledger as your oracle and **quote its entry for each of the two keys**, before and after. ⛔ If the ledger does not move when you fix a key, your fix is not the one it measures.

## Fold mechanics — ⚠️ get these exactly right

- **One branch, one PR**, with **per-card commits** — one commit for #6041, one for #6044. ⛔ Do not squash them into one commit locally.
- **One `Fixes` line per member** in the PR body: `Fixes #6041` and `Fixes #6044`, both present.
- ⚠️ **Each key keeps its own card** (#5761's ruling) — ⛔ do not close one as a duplicate of the other.
- ⚠️ **Audit the PR body for closing keywords near any OTHER issue number** — ⛔ especially **#6043**, which must stay open. **GitHub's parser ignores negation**: "excluded, not fixed: #6043" still closes #6043. Measured on #5674 yesterday.

## Verification

⚠️ **Reproduce both hard-blocks before fixing** — the 422 on save and the empty reference box on load — red for a **value** reason, ⛔ not a mount error. Predict the direction before running.

⚠️ **Commit before you ablate.** ⛔ `git checkout <ref> -- <path>` writes the **INDEX** as well as the worktree, so reading a baseline that way and restoring with `git checkout -- <path>` restores the baseline **over your work**.

⚠️ **Seven phantom-class defects were self-caught by devs in the last two days**, all one root: *an assertion or control that cannot distinguish the two states of the world.* Among them: a **shared mock object** carrying a previous test's write into the next case; an **entire harness** whose two principals degenerated to the same value; a **`grep -oE` with an unescaped `(`** returning 0 for every pattern; and a probe reporting its verdict through a `console.log` **vitest never surfaced**, so it printed the same answer in both states. ✅ State explicitly **which of your assertions would still pass if your change were reverted**, and make each control a string present in **both** versions of the file.

⚠️ **Ablate per key, not per PR** — removing #6041's fix must red **only** #6041's cases and leave #6044's green, and vice-versa. That is what "independently verifiable per key" means, and it is the fold's whole justification.

Prove every mutation on disk by grepping injected **and separately** removed text; print the landing site; ⚠️ **assert anchor uniqueness before writing, bounded to the right span** — a file-wide anchor with 2 hits was caught by that assert on #5234 tonight; restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with a cwd-independent command; confirm `git diff HEAD --stat` empty.

**Gates by name, with exit codes:** `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-designer` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (⚠️ hyphenated; echo the script name; distinguish **unbuilt-closure** red from **missing-`node_modules`** red; ⚠️ **build `./examples/**` too**), root-form vitest quoting per-test names, the downstream **prefix-form** sweep with direction **demonstrated**, eslint with merge-base delta (⚠️ plain `eslint .`; ⛔ no `--no-inline-config`), and **the #5761 parity gate itself** — that one is your oracle, ⛔ not optional.

⚠️ **The gate set grew overnight: runs now carry 25 checks, up from 19 yesterday.** New ones include `Pre-Install Import Graph Check`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check` and `Doc Fence Language Check`. ✅ Derive your set by enumerating **each CI job's own step list**, ⛔ not top-level script names.

⚠️ **Use `pnpm exec vitest run [paths]` from the repo root** — ⛔ not `pnpm --filter … test -- [paths]`, which silently drops everything after `--` (guarded, objectui#3288). ⚠️ **Zero-match pnpm trap**: a filter matching nothing prints *"No projects matched the filters"* and exits **0**. ⚠️ **A cached turbo green is not a measurement** — use `--force` on any turbo gate you treat as evidence. Run `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` rather than guessing. Changeset **`patch`** unless a published signature moves; ⛔ never `major`.

## Deliverable

Draft PR, body with **both** `Fixes #6041` and `Fixes #6044`. ⛔ Do not mark ready, ⛔ do not enqueue, ⛔ no auto-merge — the PM lands it. Post the terminal report on **this** issue (plain-text first line `os-dev-report`; ⛔ avoid short angle-bracket placeholders) and return it. State per gate: command, exit code, what a red would have meant; every re-derived site; the ledger entry for each key **before and after**; what a **half-filled draft** does before and after; that **both directions** (write and read) are covered per key; **which of your assertions would still pass on a revert**; the per-key ablation result; and any deviation with its reason.
